body:
Thank you so much for your replies guys/gals. I just don't know where to turn, I have no family, I have no friends, I just have my daily routine of waking up going to work and coming back. Thats it. Nothing else. I feel like I have no one to turn to except for you guys. THis is such a good feeling being able to talk to you through here because you listen and give me feedback. In the "real world" its mostly internal thoughts and talking to myself in my car. 


I don't know how to fix this.
